subject: general
question: Eight clowns I, J, K, L, M, N, O and P were sitting around a square table, facing the centre. Some of them were sitting at the corners, while some were sitting at the exact centre of the sides. K was sitting to the immediate left of O. J was sitting to the immediate right of M. P was sitting second to the right of L. J was sitting fourth to the left of P. N was sitting fourth to the left of K. O was sitting to the immediate left of M. M is sitting at one of the corners. Who was sitting fourth to the left of I ?
solution:
**Given:** Eight clowns I, J, K, L, M, N, O and P were sitting around a square table, facing the centre. 

M is sitting at one of the corners

1) K was sitting to the immediate left of O. 

2) J was sitting to the immediate right of M. 

3) P was sitting second to the right of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/921ec422d4221532b0dca52383c00ea14444896375338188e6507a93f8b56661.png] 

4) J was sitting fourth to the left of P. 

5) N was sitting fourth to the left of K. 

6) O was sitting to the immediate left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a6778b95754cac933d647945cf543ecbb34021c4b35b968cf24b5fa1a494117.png] 

So, **M was sitting fourth to the left of I.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
